title: How to Pay in China With No Chinese Bank Account (2026) | China Travel Expert
description:
You don't need a Chinese bank account or a local SIM to go cashless in China — your foreign card is enough.

Here's the setup: download Alipay or Weixin (WeChat), do the one-time real-name verification with your passport, then bind a foreign Visa, Mastercard, Amex or JCB. After that you just scan any QR code to pay — at shops, stalls, metro and more. A small service fee can apply on larger transactions, so it's worth checking each app's current limits. This is a how-to on the official process, not financial advice.

🧭 Expert Tip: Set both apps up and verify your passport BEFORE you land — verification is smoother on home Wi-Fi — and still carry ¥200 in cash for tiny stalls, taxis, or the rare network drop.

没有中国银行卡和手机号，用护照实名、绑外卡，照样扫码走遍中国。
